scope: Measurement and analysis only; unchanged deployed native/browser implementation. In-progress unrelated working-tree identity changes are not compiled into this capture.
methodology: Two sequential fresh-browser captures for each real project, interleaved by project; 13 operation windows per capture, 1440x960, normal motion, no throttling, Chrome 149.0.7827.53. All capture workloads complete before validation workloads start.

EventDispatch is inclusive synchronous handling. Discrete Event Timing entries at the 16ms threshold report input queuing separately. Missing entries are unavailable, not zero. Two-rAF and scene attachment are rendering proxies, not physical presentation or field INP.

Per-run p95 uses small diagnostic samples. Resize delivery may coalesce. Deep drill uses reachable categories and two extra wheel gestures until a file box is reached, with the original 650ms focus animation; action elapsed includes deliberate settling and must not be reported as event latency.

Browser CPU self times are grouped by exact matching source-map module, preserving native/unknown/idle/program/GC work. Automation hit testing is included and labelled. Nested rendering/native spans overlap and cannot be summed into exclusive wall-time shares.

Native sampling uses same-user cpu-clock at 99Hz with DWARF stacks, attached to the immutable live host and inherited workers. Current-thread CPU spans exclude workers; native sample percentages are not wall-time percentages. Bounded native-ring eviction is retained per capture.

Native source/compile/search caches and OS/project caches are retained; file opening explicitly requests validation again. Reopening an existing tab is a different workload. Initial navigation uses five visits in each fresh context, with computed/cache classified from the actual DOM. Not cold installation.
Each capture sends exactly one setup file-inspection command and no gesture commands. No model approval, model inference, source editing or host restart. Both projects remain idle/unapproved.

limits: Only the selected 15-declaration Riemann and 42-declaration EthLib compiled dependency graphs are measured; not an all-file/all-declaration latency bound.
Deep drill follows the same reproducible visible path; it is not arbitrary rapid input or every zoom level. No no-sampling comparison is run, so instrumentation overhead is not quantified.
No optimization is implemented in this audit; priority recommendations are based on measured attribution, not demonstrated savings.

Eight EthLib selections target the original GossipsubParameters.mk.inj declaration, which has an original source file but no compiler-provided line; no source-line jump is asserted for those. The other 56 selections assert their original line.
